title: Compact request (format 2)
description: What a format 2 approval or revert link carries: <base>/approvals/<approvalId>#2.<base64url(deflate-raw(this JSON))>, or the same under /reverts/<revertId>. [shapes, texts] or [shapes, texts, credentialIds]: the binding text first, then the lines in order, each text either as it is or as a shape and its values, rebuilt to the exact text. No id (the binding has it) and, optionally, the database's active credential ids, which the page passes as allowCredentials (unsigned: they only narrow the passkeys the browser offers; Postgres still checks the signature). Limits a schema cannot state: every shape is used, a shaped text has exactly one value per slot of its shape, a value of {"raw": text} is the only object value, and the rebuilt texts total at most 1 MiB. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals, Format 2.

prefixItems.description: shapes: the distinct key layouts of the texts, each listed once.
texts: the binding text, then 1 to 50 preview lines (an approval) or 1 to 1000 revert lines (a revert, or a large plan's sample).

credentialIds, optional: the database's active passkey credential ids, base64url without padding, each 1 to 1023 bytes, listed once. The page passes them as allowCredentials, so the browser offers only these passkeys.

shape.description: A text's top-level keys in text order.

entry.description: "key" takes one value; ["key", ["column", ...]] is a key whose value is an object and takes one value per column, in text order.

text.description: The text as it is, or [shape index, value, ...].

value.description: A string, true, false, null, an integer of magnitude at most 2^53 - 1 (never -0), an array of values (at most 32 deep), or {"raw": text} inserted as it is (other numbers, nested objects).
